entities.name: Query protein 398 aa
observations: Sequence length is 398 aa; estimated molecular mass 43.23 kDa and theoretical pI 7.57.
Pfam detects Flavoprotein PF02441.26 at residues 2-177 and DFP PF04127.23 at residues 187-395.
Homologs include reviewed bacterial CoaBC proteins with 42.9-47.5% identity and 98.7-99.0% query coverage.
Likely catalyzes two sequential CoA-biosynthesis reactions: CTP-dependent phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation followed by phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation.
Likely binds FMN and Mg2+, based on close reviewed CoaBC homolog annotations; exact cofactor binding is inferred rather than directly measured for this sequence.
No signal peptide or transmembrane segment is apparent from the sequence context; a soluble bacterial enzyme is likely.
Functional assignment has moderate homology support; exact substrate specificity and oligomeric state are not established from this sequence alone.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: Bacterial CoaBC homologs perform steps 2 and 3 of CoA biosynthesis from pantothenate.
The ligase reaction forms phosphopantothenoylcysteine; the decarboxylase reaction forms 4-phosphopantetheine.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: Candidate reaction: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+.
Associated EC number in reviewed CoaBC homologs: 6.3.2.5; Rhea RHEA:19397.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: Associated EC number in reviewed CoaBC homologs: 4.1.1.36; Rhea RHEA:16793.
